summary:
Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper and enum, with tests; nothing committed.

Changes:
- botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` with the eleven members from the spec (values, comments with meaning and type).
- botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults at the end of the class, with the specified parameter names and order.
- tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from tests.unittest.TestCase) covering every behavioral criterion; the S3 predicate test mocks the predicate and asserts one call.

Choices:
- The bridge exposes FIPS and DualStack only via private methods (_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var, _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint); the helper calls them, since the spec forbids reading Config or the config store directly.
- Bundled-data flag read as endpoint_bridge.endpoint_resolver.uses_builtin_data.
- Absent SDK::Endpoint is returned as a key with value None, so all eleven keys are always present.

Verification:
- tests/unit/test_args.py, test_regions.py, test_client.py: 414 passed (one pre-existing warning).
- Added lines fit in 79 columns. One pre-existing over-length line in args.py (~315) was left unchanged.
- black and isort are not in the prepared venv and were not installed; formatting was done by hand.
